parameters.name: Operations
parameters.query:
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload in ('OneDrive', 'SharePoint')
| summarize Count = count() by Operation
| order by Count desc, Operation asc
| project Value = Operation, Label = strcat(Operation, ' - ', Count)

parameters.name: Users
parameters.query:
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload in ('OneDrive', 'SharePoint')
|  where "{Operations:lable}"=="All" or Operation in ({Operations})
| summarize Count = count() by UserId
| order by Count desc, UserId asc
| project Value = UserId, Label = strcat(UserId, ' - ', Count)

content.query:
let data = OfficeActivity
| where "{Operations:lable}"=="All" or Operation in ({Operations})
| where "{Users:lable}"=="All" or UserId in ({Users})
| where OfficeWorkload in ('OneDrive', 'SharePoint');
data
| summarize Count = count() by OfficeWorkload
| join kind = fullouter (datatable(OfficeWorkload:string)['OneDrive', 'SharePoint']) on OfficeWorkload
| project OfficeWorkload = iff(OfficeWorkload == '', OfficeWorkload1, OfficeWorkload), Count = iff(OfficeWorkload == '', 0, Count)
| join kind = inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain} by OfficeWorkload)
    on OfficeWorkload
| project-away OfficeWorkload1, TimeGenerated
| extend OfficeWorkload = OfficeWorkload
| union (
    data 
    | summarize Count = count() 
    | extend jkey = 1
    | join kind=inner (data
        | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain}
        | extend jkey = 1) on jkey
    | extend OfficeWorkload = 'All', OfficeWorkloads = '*'    
)
| order by Count desc
| take 10

let data = OfficeActivity
| where "{Operations:lable}"=="All" or Operation in ({Operations})
| where "{Users:lable}"=="All" or UserId in ({Users})
| where OfficeWorkload in ('OneDrive', 'SharePoint') and ("{SelectedWorkload}"=="All" or OfficeWorkload=="{SelectedWorkload}");
let appData = data
| summarize TotalCount = count() by Operation
| join kind=inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by Operation
    | project-away TimeGenerated) on Operation
| order by TotalCount desc, Operation asc
| project Operation, TotalCount, Trend
| serialize Id = row_number();
data
| summarize TotalCount = count() by UserId , Operation
| join kind=inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by Operation, UserId
    | project-away TimeGenerated) on Operation, UserId
| order by TotalCount desc, Operation asc
| project Operation, UserId, TotalCount, Trend
| serialize Id = row_number(1000000)
| join kind=inner (appData) on Operation
| project Id, Name = UserId, Type = 'UserId', ['Operations Count'] = TotalCount, Trend,  ParentId = Id1
| union (appData 
    | project Id, Name = Operation, Type = 'Operation', ['Operations Count'] = TotalCount,  Trend)
| order by ['Operations Count'] desc, Name asc

let details = dynamic({OperationDetail});
OfficeActivity
| where "{Operations:lable}"=="All" or Operation in ({Operations})
| where "{Users:lable}"=="All" or UserId in ({Users})
| where OfficeWorkload in ('OneDrive', 'SharePoint') and ("{SelectedWorkload}"=="All" or OfficeWorkload=="{SelectedWorkload}")
| where details.Type == '*' or (details.Type == 'Operation' and Operation == details.Name) or (details.Type == 'UserId' and UserId == details.Name)
| summarize Amount = count() by Operation, bin_at(TimeGenerated, 1d, now()) 
| sort by Amount
content.title: Activities over time

content.query:
let data = OfficeActivity
| where "{Operations:lable}"=="All" or Operation in ({Operations})
| where "{Users:lable}"=="All" or UserId in ({Users})
| where Operation contains "file"
| where OfficeWorkload in ('OneDrive', 'SharePoint') and ("{SelectedWorkload}"=="All" or OfficeWorkload=="{SelectedWorkload}");
let appData = data
| summarize TotalCount = count() by Operation
| join kind=inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by Operation
    | project-away TimeGenerated) on Operation
| order by TotalCount desc, Operation asc
| project Operation, TotalCount, Trend
| serialize Id = row_number();
data
| summarize TotalCount = count() by SourceFileExtension , Operation
| join kind=inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by Operation, SourceFileExtension
    | project-away TimeGenerated) on Operation, SourceFileExtension
| order by TotalCount desc, Operation asc
| project Operation, SourceFileExtension, TotalCount, Trend
| serialize Id = row_number(1000000)
| join kind=inner (appData) on Operation
| project Id, Name = SourceFileExtension, Type = 'SourceFileExtension', ['Operations Count'] = TotalCount, Trend,  ParentId = Id1
| union (appData 
    | project Id, Name = Operation, Type = 'Operation', ['Operations Count'] = TotalCount,  Trend)
| order by ['Operations Count'] desc, Name asc
content.title: File Operations

content.query:
let details = dynamic({FileOperations});
OfficeActivity 
| where "{Operations:lable}"=="All" or Operation in ({Operations})
| where "{Users:lable}"=="All" or UserId in ({Users})
| where OfficeWorkload in ('OneDrive', 'SharePoint') and ("{SelectedWorkload}"=="All" or OfficeWorkload=="{SelectedWorkload}")
| where Site_Url != '' 
| where details.Type == '*' or (details.Type == 'Operation' and Operation == details.Name) or (details.Type == 'SourceFileExtension' and SourceFileExtension == details.Name)
| summarize Number = count() by SourceFileName, SourceFileExtension, UserId, Operation, DestinationFileName, DestinationFileExtension, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by Number, TimeGenerated
